why_separate: panel 2 HALTed on a cap line during its DUPLICATE phase, after all 20 probes completed. Its directory stays marked HALTED with no summary.json - the registered marker of an incomplete run - so the pooled verdict is emitted here, citing both panels, rather than fabricated into that directory.

chain1b_lr2.reading: every one of 20 episodes succeeds by 500 steps; L=250 cuts the completion-time distribution near its median. No capability headroom exists, so no deadline yields both non-degenerate success and genuine failure.

chain2b_lr2.band_note: official 31/40 = 0.775 at L=500 exceeds the 0.70 PASS-band ceiling its V8.0 gate was granted under; pooled with the V8.0 confirm panel it is 51/70 = 0.729. This is a second challenge, independent of the deadline.

registered_overrun.cause: the cap funded ONE duplicate subset (DUPLICATE_N x deadline) but the runner scheduled one per panel. The panel-2 subset was unfunded. Recorded as an overrun rather than repaired by raising the cap: caps are not raised after execution. CAP_LINE now maps DUPLICATE_CHECK for panel 2 to no line, so an unfunded subset cannot be scheduled again.
registered_overrun.evidence_obtained_anyway: 3/3 panel-2 duplicate checks matched, as did 10/10 in panel 1

action_1R_consequence: framework §14.4 PASS requires BOTH frozen tasks to retain an admissible stratum. chain1b has none. Action 1R therefore HALTs, and §6 permits changing exactly one registered component - task/deadline, anchor rule, or estimator path - before any new panel.
